name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SEO Manager
summary: SEO and performance marketing professional with 15+ years running technical SEO audits, keyword and competitor research, and content strategy for B2B and SMB clients, backed by real campaign-to-revenue accountability. Founded and operate an independent marketing-operations business (Solenzo), building and testing systems end to end with full ownership of outcomes. At Wix, SEO-informed growth work contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment. Comfortable digging into how a platform or algorithm actually works, testing new tools and AI-driven approaches, and moving fast on what the data shows.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword-gap analyses, and competitor research, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Architect AI-driven marketing systems, breaking down manual workflows into agent architectures with custom logic for scoring and outreach.
Design self-improving evaluation frameworks to monitor campaign outputs, separating signal from noise and continuously optimizing conversion rates.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Own the full lifecycle of client strategy, execution, and reporting as an independent operator, with direct accountability for outcomes.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.
Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (roughly 94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data at a performance marketing agency, translating results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
